embeds.title: 👀  What 1.5.1 looks like
embeds.description:
**The button.** Left-click opens your To-Do List. Right-click opens the menu. Hover it and it tells you what each click does.
*Screenshots are from 1.5.0. Game Plan is now called **To-Do List** and Tracker is now **Party & Upkeep**.*

fields.name: 1️⃣  To-Do List
fields.value: Your own checklist. Tick steps off, reorder with the arrows, x to remove. The gold arrow points at your next stop and shows how far it is.

fields.name: 2️⃣  Party tab
fields.value: Quests you and your group both have, in order. **+ To-Do** drops one onto your list. **Skip** takes one off.

fields.name: 3️⃣  Share tab
fields.value: Every quest your party has that you don't. Hit **Ask** and it gets shared to you. No typing, nothing in chat.

fields.name: 4️⃣  Dungeons
fields.value: Right-click, then Dungeons. Tick the ones you want to run and guildies in range get a heads-up.

embeds.title: 🤝  And it tells you who's nearby
embeds.description: Walk into a zone where a guildie is questing and you get one chat line: who's there and how many quests you share. Then open the **Party** or **Share** tab and go.

footer: Party and Share only see people who also run Guild Board  ·  For the Horde
